compos.text: Alt text: "Text explaining color desaturation and its effects on vision. It states that color desaturation may occur disproportionately to retention of acuity and form perception. The optic nerve is sensitive to red, so when it is damaged, red-colored objects may appear dull, washed-out, or faded. Some patients with optic neuropathy describe red as appearing orange or pink. This may indicate a problem with the optic nerve or nerve tracts. Any changes in red desaturation should be reported to a doctor."

The image shows a smartphone status bar with the following icons from left to right:

1. Facebook icon (repeated three times)
2. Information icon (a circle with an "i" inside)
3. Lock icon (indicating the device is locked)
4. Android icon (representing the Android operating system)
5. Bluetooth icon (indicating Bluetooth is enabled)

8. Time display (showing "12:21")
